summary: Enhanced Group Inc. filed an 8-K to provide retroactively recast audited financial statements of Enhanced Ltd for 2024-2025, following its May 7, 2026 business combination with A Paradise Acquisition Corp. The transaction was accounted for as a reverse recapitalization, with Enhanced Ltd as accounting acquirer. Share amounts are adjusted using an exchange ratio of 7.6021255. The filing is routine post-closing financial statement disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms or new event; watch for future operational updates only.
